run_cmd: run a shell command with optional environment variables, working directory, and log file output
run_cmd_allow_fail: run a shell command that may fail without raising an exception by setting allow_fail to True
run_cmd_log_file: run a shell command and append its output to a specified log file path
RunCommandError: catch RunCommandError exceptions raised when a command fails to execute or has quoting issues
_pipe_output: pipe subprocess stdout output to a logging function using non-blocking reads with select.poll
